guide.justifylasers.photopolymer_printer: Build a 2×2×2 cube from eight printer casings. Supply FE, liquid photopolymer and a violet beam (hue 260–305°) to a lower side lens. Insert a programmed model schematic. Costs depend on volume and detail; power and light must remain connected. Schematics are reusable. Progress pauses without inputs and survives reloads.
guide.justifylasers.photopolymer_bucket: Liquid printing material made in the chemical synthesizer. Supply it to a photopolymer printer through a fluid port or its bucket slot. Each printed part consumes polymer according to its volume and detail. FE drives the mechanism; a violet laser cures the polymer.
guide.justifylasers.model_schematic: A reusable model blueprint written in the model encoder. Import a supported file or draw a voxel model, insert a writable card and supply 2,000 FE to record it. Place the programmed schematic in a photopolymer printer. Large designs are printed as separately numbered parts.
guide.justifylasers.printed_model: A decorative block produced by a photopolymer printer. Its shape, face textures and colors come from the recorded model; copied blocks do not retain inventories or machine functions. Multipart designs consist of separate printed blocks. Break a placed print to recover it for reuse.
guide.justifylasers.model_encoder: Import Blockbench Java JSON, MagicaVoxel or WorldEdit/Sponge .schem using File. WorldEdit scale: 1:16 miniature or 1:1 before import; block models, states and per-face UVs come from installed mods/resource packs. Large models print as separate parts. WorldEdit itself is not required. Drafts autosave. Writing: 2,000 FE; hologram: 2 FE/t. Prints are decorative; inventories and block functions are never copied.

guide.justifylasers.light_bridge:
Projects a walkable light surface without placing blocks. Feed any face except the front with a laser or solar beam; the bridge inherits its color. More light gives more length, up to the configured limit (256 blocks by default).

Place matching projectors side by side to join up to three lanes. They can face walls, floors or ceilings. Roll a projector with the Configurator's 45° mode; use a corner projector to close the corners of a tunnel. Without power the bridge disappears: plan a safe way down.
tooltip.justifylasers.seed_recipe: Workbench: raw photonite + the matching gem
gui.justifylasers.client.cube_core.toolt: Show the inner glowing sphere of a lit refocusing cube. Lenses, beam routing and world lighting are unchanged.
guide.justifylasers.first_steps:
1. Mine Wolframite and Photonite. Smelt raw wolframite into ingots; keep raw photonite for growth.

2. Craft an Electric Motor, a Fuel Generator and Assembly Chamber blocks. Build the chamber, connect FE and supply fuel.

3. Find the tablet schematic in dungeon, shipwreck or other structure chests. Assemble the tablet from a Control Circuit, Eye of Ender, Wolframite Ingot and Gold Ingot. Charge it in the generator.

4. Open Schematics and record the plans you need onto blank schematics. Plans are reusable. You can record a tablet schematic for another player too.

5. Assemble absorbers and a Small Solar Concentrator. Build a Crystal Growth Chamber; supply its optical port with sunlight-derived LM and fill it with water. Raw photonite and quartz produce the first Photonite Crystal.

6. Fit the crystal into a mount and assemble the optical parts and Powered Laser Emitter. Connect FE, install a crystal and add range modules. You now have a controllable optical power source.
guide.justifylasers.power:
FE powers electrical devices. LM measures the light currently arriving through a beam: it is a flow, not a battery. 1 klm = 1,000 lm; 1 Mlm = 1,000 klm; then Glm and Tlm.

The generator and compatible energy mods provide FE. Emitters turn FE into a beam; solar concentrators need sunlight instead. The Energy Receiver converts a beam back into FE with losses.

Growers and light bridges require optical input. More useful light speeds growth and extends bridges. Splitters divide a budget; combiners sum it with losses. Range is shared by the whole optical route, not renewed at each block.

Modules consume part of the light budget. Installed and placed effects can combine; equally strong Lift and Descent cancel. Watch the received and consumed flux in the device menu.
guide.justifylasers.multiblocks:
Assembly, growth and cutting chambers each use eight matching casing blocks in a 2×2×2 cube. Right-click the completed structure to open it. Do not mix different kinds of casing.

The large Solar Concentrator is a 3×3×3 installation with optical resonators around its base. Use a machine's Help button to inspect the exact layer-by-layer layout; JEI can also show it.

Leave a clear view of the sun. Dishes track it; output falls toward sunset and stops at night or when the sun is obstructed. Select an outlet with the Configurator. Start with a small concentrator before assembling the large one.
guide.justifylasers.cultivation:
First photonite: raw photonite + 2 quartz + water + any beam. Speed scales with light; basic growth can fail.

For advanced cultivation, craft a Growth Seed from raw photonite and the matching gem. Prepare nutrient in the Chemical Synthesizer and tune the beam spectrum.

One batch consumes 1,000 mB of nutrient and grows one cluster. Cut it to obtain 3, 4, 5 or 6 normal resources with probabilities of 55%, 30%, 12% and 3%. The complete chain yields 3–6 resources per bucket, averaging 3.63, before replacement seed costs.

Seeds wear after each batch. FE/LM, spectrum and cutting requirements still apply.
guide.justifylasers.automation:
Use compatible item pipes, hoppers and storage buses on any accessible side of a formed chamber. Inputs accept recipe ingredients; output slots allow extraction. Fluids use fluid pipes, not item pipes. Buckets use their own slots.

Configure privacy and redstone in the machine menu. Private machinery blocks external inventory access. A disassembled structure cannot be automated. Check these settings first if a pipe does not transfer items.

Mining collectors and emitters have nine-slot storage. Enable drops and collection, and extract items with compatible pipes or buses. Overflow falls into the world rather than disappearing.

JEI is optional. The Recipes button opens the current machine's recipes when JEI is installed; Help opens its construction guide. Neither Mekanism nor AE2 is required to play.
guide.justifylasers.growth_seed: Workbench: one raw photonite + one %s. Supply this seed, matching nutrient, spectrum and sufficient light to advanced growth. One bucket grows one cluster; the cutter yields 3–6 gems. Seeds wear after each batch; a fragment lasts one more batch. Removing the seed pauses paid work.
guide.justifylasers.assembly_blueprint: A reusable Assembly Chamber plan. Its stored recipe determines its name and output icon. Place it in the schematic slot and add the displayed ingredients. It is not consumed during assembly. Record more plans with the tablet and blank schematics. Craft a configured schematic by itself to erase it into a blank one; the old plan is lost.
guide.justifylasers.blank_schematic: An empty writable card. Keep it in your inventory, open the tablet's Schematics tab, select a plan and press Record. Recording uses one card and tablet charge. Clear a configured schematic in any crafting grid to recover a blank card.
guide.justifylasers.wolframite_ore: A source of raw wolframite, found in stone and deepslate. Mine with a suitable pickaxe, then smelt the raw material into ingots. Fortune increases raw drops; Silk Touch preserves the ore block. Wolframite is the starting metal for generators, frames and optical equipment.
guide.justifylasers.photonic_crystal_ore: A rarer source of raw photonite in stone and deepslate. Fortune increases raw drops and Silk Touch preserves the ore. The raw material feeds initial photonite growth, nutrient synthesis and new growth seeds. A grown gem cannot replace raw photonite in those recipes.
guide.justifylasers.wolframite_ingot: Smelt raw wolframite in a furnace or blast furnace. Ingots form the structural metal of the mod: generator, crystal mounts, reinforced housings and optical parts. Begin by making the generator and Assembly Chamber; later reserve some ingots for the tablet and mounted crystals.
guide.justifylasers.photonite_crystal: The active optical material grown from raw photonite, quartz and water under a beam. Combine it with a Crystal Mount to make a usable laser crystal. Advanced growth and cutting provide another supply later. It also provides the matching gem for a photonite Growth Seed.
guide.justifylasers.crystal_mount: Holds photonite in a laser-compatible housing. Combine it with a Photonite Crystal in a crafting grid to obtain a magenta laser crystal. Recolor it in the Chemical Synthesizer using water and a mineral reagent. The empty mount cannot activate an emitter. It can also be placed as decoration.
guide.justifylasers.grown_crystal: An uncut crystal cluster produced by advanced growth. Feed it into a formed Laser Cutter and supply FE plus the required LM to obtain its matching usable gem. This is not a growth seed. Clusters can be placed as translucent, emissive decorations on floors, walls and ceilings.
guide.justifylasers.nutrient_bucket: A bucket of nutrient for the matching advanced crystal recipe. Prepare the fluid from water and reagents in the Chemical Synthesizer. Transfer it to the grower with fluid pipes or buckets. Each complete growth batch uses 1,000 mB. A different nutrient or ordinary water cannot run an advanced recipe.
guide.justifylasers.reinforced_laser_hou: The structural body of emitters, guns and optical machines. Assemble it from wolframite and iron using its schematic. It replaces the old Laser Chassis. Also placeable as a structural/decorative block and used in the large solar installation.
guide.justifylasers.optical_resonator: Amplifies and shapes light inside optical equipment. Assemble from a Focusing Lens Assembly, wolframite, a Beam Controller and quartz. Required by emitters, refocusing cubes and other optics. Placed resonators form configurable laser outlets on the large solar concentrator.
guide.justifylasers.energy_core: An electrical power component for emitters, weapons and energy receivers. Assemble copper, redstone, quartz and control circuits using its schematic. It is a crafting component, not a standalone generator or battery. Placeable as decoration.
guide.justifylasers.focusing_lens_assemb: The common focusing optics for weapons, mirrors, receivers, modules and resonators. Assemble glass, quartz, amethyst and wolframite using its schematic. It replaces Optical Assembly. A placed lens assembly is a component/decorative block, not a working mirror.
guide.justifylasers.beam_controller: Precision control electronics for turrets, splitters, combiners and effect modules. Assemble control circuits, a comparator, copper and redstone using its schematic. Placeable as a component/decorative block; also part of the large solar installation.
gui.justifylasers.client.gpu_models.tool: Keep machine and optical model geometry on the graphics card. Preserves textures, lighting and shadows. Disable to use the compatibility renderer.
gui.justifylasers.client.gpu_prints.tool: Reuse uploaded VOX, JSON and schematic geometry. Translucent surfaces retain Minecraft's sorting. Does not change print detail.
gui.justifylasers.client.gpu_effects.too: Animate cached light geometry on the GPU. Disable to use the compatibility renderer; beam gameplay and visual detail do not change.
gui.justifylasers.client.gpu_memory.tool: Maximum cached geometry memory for this mod, not total game VRAM. 64 MiB is the default. Uncached geometry uses the compatibility renderer; nothing is hidden. Changes apply immediately.
gui.justifylasers.client.gpu_upload.tool: Limits new uploads to reduce frame-time spikes while entering complex scenes. A single mesh may exceed this per-frame allowance, but never the cache limit. Lower values warm the cache more gradually.
gui.justifylasers.client.machine_display: Render live text and gauges on machine models. Disable to reduce rendering work; machine GUIs remain available.

tooltip.justifylasers.amplifier.upgrade: Upgrade: 8 of the same level around a control circuit
guide.justifylasers.amplifier_module: Install 1–64 amplifiers of the same level in the powered emitter's Amplifier slot. Available levels I–IV add 32 klm, 256 klm, 2.048 Mlm or 16.384 Mlm per item, consuming an extra 34, 272, 2,176 or 17,408 FE/t respectively. Output and power draw scale with the installed count. Eight identical amplifiers around a Control Circuit make the next available level. Levels V–VI are temporarily unavailable. Not placeable.
message.justifylasers.configurator_help: Hold the Configurator mode wheel key (Left Ctrl by default).
gui.justifylasers.client.mirror_reflecti: Off: the base surface without a second world render. On: a real reflection. Nested reflections are not rendered. Vanilla lighting is used unless mirror shaders are enabled.
Experimental Iris/Oculus rendering with separate shadow maps and history for each mirror. Very high GPU and video-memory cost. Off by default. Unsupported versions fall back to vanilla lighting.
gui.justifylasers.client.mirror_distance: Beyond this distance, mirrors use the base surface without an additional world render.
gui.justifylasers.client.mirror_limit.to: 1–32 nearest mirrors rendered every frame. Each adds a full world render. Above 4 can severely reduce performance and use substantial video memory; the slider turns red.
tooltip.justifylasers.bridge_placement: Floor/ceiling: along your heading. Wall: outwards. Extend a bridge to copy its orientation. Sneak: independent placement.
tooltip.justifylasers.mirror_aim: Aim mode: click two mirrors to link; hold use and move the mouse to aim manually.
item.justifylasers.corner_light_bridge_b: Schematic: Corner Hard Light Bridge Emitter
tooltip.justifylasers.corner_light_bridg: Joins perpendicular light sheets. Connected sections share their LM budget.
guide.justifylasers.corner_light_bridge: An L-shaped projector for hard-light tunnels. Align its two ends with straight emitters, facing in the same projection direction. Joined sections share incoming light and color; a corner costs two lanes of the length budget. Power can enter any face except the front. Rotate the cross-section in 45° steps using the Configurator.

guide.justifylasers.block_collection_mod:
A nine-slot loot collector. Install inside Mining settings to store mined drops in the emitter or placed mining module. Drops must also be enabled. Overflow falls into the world.

Place on a beam route to add collection to downstream mining. Right-click opens storage; the chest's small screen displays its contents. Compatible pipes and storage buses can extract stored items.
gui.justifylasers.creative_flux.tooltip: Creative optical power: 0–1 Tlm. Powers receivers, bridges, growers and world modules without consuming FE.
gui.justifylasers.world_module.block_col: Collects downstream mined drops in this module.
gui.justifylasers.world_module.priority: Effects apply downstream and combine with other modules.
gui.justifylasers.world_module.silk_touc: Adds Silk Touch to beam mining.
gui.justifylasers.world_module.block_dro: Enables loot from blocks mined by the beam.
gui.justifylasers.world_module.ignition_: Ignites damage targets and smelts mined drops.
guide.justifylasers.entity_heal_module: Restores 0.1 HP per second while a living entity touches the paid beam. Fixed rate, with target filtering available.
guide.justifylasers.entity_lift_module: Smoothly raises filtered targets without removing horizontal control or collision. Speed increases energy cost. Can be installed in an emitter or placed in a beam, including solar light.
guide.justifylasers.entity_lower_module: Controls a smooth descent while a filtered target touches the beam. Adds to other beam effects; equally strong Lift and Descent cancel each other.
tooltip.justifylasers.light_bridge.input: Input: all faces except the front.
tooltip.justifylasers.light_bridge.width: Join up to 3 emitters side by side.
guide.justifylasers.electric_motor: Workbench recipe: 4 iron ingots, 4 copper ingots and redstone. No schematic, power or photonite required.
guide.justifylasers.small_solar_concentr: Up to 16 klm; 32-block range. Tracks the sun and stops at night, in rain or shade. Assemble with 3 absorbers, an Electric Motor and 3 iron ingots. Enough to grow photonite. The large installation uses 17 of these blocks and provides up to 480 klm.
guide.justifylasers.solar_absorber: Assembled from its schematic. Three absorbers make a small concentrator. The large installation uses completed small concentrators.
guide.justifylasers.laser_absorbing_glas: Workbench: 4 glass, 2 Wolframite Ingots and 1 grown photonite. Stops lasers and resists laser mining. Used in the large solar installation.
gui.justifylasers.industry.growth_refere: 1× growth speed at %s; scales with light input

guide.justifylasers.beam_combiner:
Five inputs and one output by default. The Configurator cycles each face through input, output and disabled. Assigning a new output turns the previous output into an input. All outputs can be disabled.

Sums incoming luminous flux with a 5% loss per combiner. Energy receivers convert the resulting flux using their normal efficiency. Color is weighted by incoming power. Mirrors, splitters, crystals and refocusing cubes remain compatible; incoming range is never renewed. Cyclic routes stop; creative sources provide adjustable test power.
tooltip.justifylasers.tablet_schematic: Found in structure chests or recorded with a charged tablet.
guide.justifylasers.tablet_schematic:
Find the first reusable schematic in structure chests: shipwreck treasure 25%, dungeons 20%, mineshafts 15%, desert pyramids 15%, jungle temples 20%, stronghold libraries 35%, ancient cities 25%.

Assemble the tablet with a Control Circuit, Eye of Ender, Wolframite Ingot and Gold Ingot: 30 seconds at 144 energy/tick. Charge the depleted tablet in a Fuel Generator. A charged tablet can record its own schematic as well: one blank schematic and 1000 energy per copy. Copies can be traded and reused by other players.

gui.justifylasers.jei.solar_assembly: 3×3×3 + four lower resonators. Configure one output.

guide.justifylasers.laser_saber: Single-handed LightSaber. Move and attack to select a cut; right-click guards the front. A timed block parries and opens a counterattack window. Stamina limits blocks and chains. Sneak + right-click changes color; the ignition key defaults to V. Assembled from a schematic. With a weapon in each hand, right-click controls the physical right hand and left-click the left. Dual wielding replaces aiming/guarding with a second attack; change colors in single-weapon mode.
guide.justifylasers.light_staff: Double-bladed Light-Staff: wide three-cut chains, with the third cut using the returning blade. Controls more targets but consumes more stamina. Uses the same guard and controls as the LightSaber. Assembled from a schematic. With a weapon in each hand, right-click controls the physical right hand and left-click the left. Dual wielding replaces aiming/guarding with a second attack; change colors in single-weapon mode.

gui.justifylasers.client.lens_limit.tool: Render lenses only on the nearest N cubes each frame. Useful in large installations.
gui.justifylasers.client.scorch_marks.to: Show local scorch decals from emitters, guns and sabers. Disabling clears existing local marks and stops creating new ones. It does not alter block destruction.

gui.justifylasers.client.weapon_sway.too: Subtle movement while holding weapons. Disabling removes idle/walking sway, not attack animations or recoil.
gui.justifylasers.client.sound_volume.to: Local volume multiplier for emitter, gun and saber effects. Minecraft's sound sliders still apply.
gui.justifylasers.client.sound_limit.too: Local voice budget. The lower of this and the common configuration limit is used. Nearest sources take priority.
gui.justifylasers.turret.exclude_hint:
Excluded players: %s / 32
Enter an online player's name to exclude them.
Enter the same name again to remove the exclusion.
guide.justifylasers.laser_gun: Hold Attack to fire and Use to aim through the transparent 2.5× sight. Sneak + Use cycles colors. Surface impacts leave cooling scorch trails. Armor, damage resistance and shields still apply. Range, damage, hit rate and knockback are configurable. This prototype needs no energy. With a weapon in each hand, right-click controls the physical right hand and left-click the left. Dual wielding replaces aiming/guarding with a second attack; change colors in single-weapon mode.
guide.justifylasers.laser_turret: Place a Laser Gun on the stand with Use, then open its menu. Install a Target Filter Module to choose target categories. Without a filter, only hostile mobs are targeted. Obstacles and friendly entities block shots. Only the owner or a creative player can configure it. Energy is not required yet.

message.justifylasers.splitter: Configure each face with the configurator: input, output or disabled. Power is shared between enabled outputs.
message.justifylasers.filter_player_unav: Player must be online to add an exclusion. Up to 32 players; existing names can be removed offline.

message.justifylasers.select_mirror: Right-click a mirror first. Select Aim again in the radial menu to reset the selection.

message.justifylasers.mirror_needs_beam: Aim requires a laser striking the mirror.

gui.justifylasers.powered.slot_hint.filt: Choose which entities may be damaged. Does not increase damage or reduce energy use.
guide.justifylasers.crystal:
Grow photonite with quartz, water and light, then combine a Photonite Crystal with a Crystal Mount to obtain a magenta laser crystal. Recolor any laser crystal in the Chemical Synthesizer with the corresponding reagent and 1000 mB water. Install it in a powered emitter to select the color and enable operation; it is not consumed.

Place on floors, walls or ceilings to recolor passing beams. Right-click switches replacement/additive mixing. Only the outgoing section changes color.
guide.justifylasers.laser_emitter:
Creative emitter: no survival recipe, modules or energy requirement. Its adjustable 0–1 Tlm output powers optical devices; an energy receiver can convert it to FE. Use the Powered Laser Emitter in survival; all machines are available without other technical mods.

Right-click to configure color, beam range and width, redstone control, mining and entity damage. Minecraft lighting and shader emission are independent.
guide.justifylasers.powered_laser_emitte:
Made in the Assembly Chamber, with its supplied crystal preinstalled. Supply energy through compatible cables, then install a color crystal. Without range modules the beam reaches one block. Open Modules to install upgrades; dedicated mining and damage modules unlock their settings.

Higher mining speed, damage, hit rate, knockback and ignition increase consumption. Range and thickness stacks add their own per-tick cost. Redstone can be ignored, required or inverted. Private access protects settings and inventory. Energy is charged only while operation is allowed.
guide.justifylasers.laser_receiver: Point the input lens toward the incoming beam. While receiving, the other five faces output redstone. Right-click to adjust strength, inversion, color filter and emission. The model follows the received color. This receiver handles redstone, not FE.
guide.justifylasers.laser_mirror:
Mount on any surface. The pane reflects beams according to its actual angle; the frame follows the incoming light color.

In the configurator's Aim mode, click one mirror, then a second mirror to link them. No beam is required. Hold right-click and move the mouse for manual rotation; the camera stays fixed. Horizontal movement turns the stand; vertical movement tilts the pane. Manual rotation clears the link. Reflections share the emitter's remaining range.

Client settings switch between transparent glass and a real reflected world view. Shader-pack reflections are optional and off by default; they require much more GPU time and memory. Up to 32 mirrors can be enabled, with warnings above four.
guide.justifylasers.beam_splitter:
Six configurable faces, including top and bottom. In Ports mode, right-click a face to cycle Laser input → Laser output → Disabled. One inward chevron marks an input; two outward chevrons mark an output; a shutter marks a disabled face.

New splitters start with one input and five outputs. Damage, knockback, mining progress and transferable energy are shared equally between enabled outputs, never duplicated. Each branch keeps its incoming color and remaining range. With no outputs the beam is absorbed. Existing three-output splitters retain their old layout when upgraded.
guide.justifylasers.energy_receiver:
Use the configurator on any face to select Laser input, Energy output or Disabled. Lenses accept beams; contact grilles export FE. New receivers have one laser input and five energy outputs. The model follows the incoming beam's color and turns gray with no emission when the beam stops.

A powered beam recovers a configurable fraction of energy actually paid by its emitter that tick (80% by default). Obstacles, missing power and redstone shutdown stop new transfer. Stored FE remains available through enabled outputs only. Split branches share the paid budget. Creative emitters provide adjustable LM for conversion; optical loops cannot create energy.
guide.justifylasers.configurator:
Hold the mode-wheel key (Left Ctrl by default; rebind in Controls) with the Configurator in hand. Point at a sector and release the key to choose it; the centre or Esc cancels. Ports, Copy, Paste, Aim, 45° rotation and Charge have different indicator colors. The tool stores 20,000 FE and spends 20 FE per successful configuration; creative use is free. Charge in a generator, compatible charger, or by using Charge mode on a powered machine.

Ports sets emitter direction or cycles the clicked optical port. The 45° mode rolls a bridge around its projection axis. Copy and Paste transfer emitter settings, never energy, modules, storage or ownership.

Aim: click the source mirror, then the destination mirror, even without a beam. Hold right-click on a mirror and move the mouse to rotate it instead. Selecting Aim again clears the previous selection.
guide.justifylasers.refocusing_cube:
Accepts beams on five sides and redirects through its output lens. Use to carry or release; aim while carrying to direct the output. Attack kicks it, sprinting kicks harder. Sneak + Use rotates a standing cube; sneak + Attack returns it to inventory, or deletes it in creative.

Client settings independently control magnifying lenses and the inner glowing sphere. Hiding the sphere affects only appearance, not beam redirection.
guide.justifylasers.silk_touch_module: Unlocks Silk Touch in mining settings. Requires the Block Destruction module and enabled block drops. Uses normal loot rules; it does not make unbreakable blocks mineable.
guide.justifylasers.block_drops_module: Unlocks block drops in mining settings. Requires the Block Destruction module. With drops disabled, no block items, container contents or mining experience are created.
guide.justifylasers.scorch_marks_module: A reserved visual upgrade. Its emitter slot is currently disabled; surface marks remain available through the existing scorch settings. It does not increase mining speed or damage. The item can still be crafted and placed as decoration.
guide.justifylasers.ignition_module: Inside Entity Damage settings, ignites hit targets that are not immune to fire. Inside Mining settings, smelts drops with a matching smelting recipe. Requires the corresponding primary effect and sufficient optical power. Excluded targets are not ignited.
guide.justifylasers.block_destruction_mo:
Install in the emitter's Effect slot or place in a beam. Open settings to enable mining and adjust speed. Both forms use the same light-cost rules; faster mining requires more LM.

Mining has its own module slots: Drops creates loot, Silk Touch preserves suitable blocks, Collection stores drops, and Ignition smelts compatible results. Unbreakable blocks and protection rules still apply. Solar beams can gain mining through a placed module.
guide.justifylasers.entity_damage_module: Enables entity damage and its settings button. Adjust 0.1–20 HP per hit, 1–20 hits per second at 20 TPS, and knockback. Armor, resistance and other normal reductions still apply. Higher settings consume more energy. Ignition and target filtering require separate modules.
guide.justifylasers.range_module: Stack up to 64 in the range slot. Each tier-I module adds one block of total optical range and 1 FE/t of operating cost. Reflections and branches do not reset that range.
guide.justifylasers.advanced_range_modul: Assemble eight tier-I range modules and a Control Circuit using the Advanced Range schematic. Each tier-II module adds eight blocks and 8 FE/t. Stack up to 64 for a maximum of 512 blocks; the last module is charged in full even at the cap.
guide.justifylasers.thickness_module: Stack up to 64 in the thickness slot to increase the beam from 0.1× to 10× width. Each installed item adds 1 FE/t. Thickness changes the hit area and sound, but does not multiply damage per target.
guide.justifylasers.target_filter_module:
Restricts which entities receive beam effects. Choose players, hostile and passive creatures; the type list includes installed mods. A whitelist permits selected types; a blacklist excludes them. Owner and named-player exclusions are also available.

Filtering applies to damage, healing and movement. Turrets without a filter target hostile mobs only. The module does not add an effect or increase damage by itself.
guide.justifylasers.control_circuit: Basic control electronics, crafted in a workbench. Used in machines, the tablet, optical components and amplifier upgrades. Placeable as a decorative circuit board, but not an emitter upgrade by itself.
gui.justifylasers.powered.security_hint: Public: shared access. Private: owner only.
gui.justifylasers.powered.owner_only: Only the owner or an admin can change access.
gui.justifylasers.powered.security_scope: Protects controls, installed parts and player mining.

gui.justifylasers.powered.redstone_energ: Blocked by redstone = no energy consumption.
gui.justifylasers.powered.preview_hint: Drag to rotate. Range: %s blocks. Thickness: %s×.
gui.justifylasers.powered.slot_hint.crys: Install one color crystal. The emitter cannot run without it.
gui.justifylasers.powered.slot_hint.silk: Silk Touch module. Configure in block destruction settings.
gui.justifylasers.powered.slot_hint.drop: Block collection module. Enables normal block loot.
gui.justifylasers.powered.slot_hint.scor: Temporarily disabled: no new modules can be inserted here. Existing modules can be removed. Surface marks remain enabled.
gui.justifylasers.powered.slot_hint.igni: Ignition module. Configure in entity damage settings.
gui.justifylasers.powered.slot_hint.mini: Block destruction module. Required for mining and its settings.
gui.justifylasers.powered.slot_hint.dama: Effect: Mining, Damage, Healing, Lift or Descent. World modules add further effects downstream. Open settings to install effect upgrades.
gui.justifylasers.powered.slot_hint.rang: Tier I: +1 block and +1 %1$s/t each. Tier II: +8 blocks and +8 %1$s/t each. Stack: 64. Base range: 1; cap: 512 blocks. Loaded chunks only.
gui.justifylasers.powered.slot_hint.thic: Up to 64 thickness modules, +1 %s/t each. Empty: 0.1×. Full stack: 10×.
item.justifylasers.refocusing_cube.input: Five inputs · One output with a double brass rim
item.justifylasers.refocusing_cube.rotat: Sneak + right-click: rotate on the ground
item.justifylasers.refocusing_cube.colle: Sneak + attack: collect · Sprint + attack: stronger kick
message.justifylasers.cube_occupied: Another player is carrying this cube

death.attack.justifylasers.laser.player: %1$s was cut down by a laser while fighting %2$s
gui.justifylasers.light_emission.tooltip: Beam and model-strip emission, colored lighting and reflections while shaders are enabled.
gui.justifylasers.minecraft_lighting.too: Vanilla Minecraft light around the emitter block (level 15). Independent of shader emission.
gui.justifylasers.mining_speed.tooltip: Minimum keeps the original hardness-based mining time. Maximum mines one breakable block per game tick (20 blocks/s at 20 TPS). Intermediate values shorten the mining time. Unbreakable blocks remain protected. Arrow keys adjust by one step.
gui.justifylasers.silk_touch.tooltip: Use vanilla Silk Touch loot where supported, such as stone, glass and ores. Requires block drops to be enabled.
gui.justifylasers.drop_blocks.tooltip: Drop mined blocks and their normal loot. When disabled, directly mined blocks drop no items or experience; container contents are also removed.
gui.justifylasers.scorch_marks.tooltip: Show surface burn marks from this emitter, including refocused beams. Works independently of block destruction. Disabling clears this emitter's existing marks.
gui.justifylasers.ignite_entities.toolti: Successful, unblocked hits ignite entities for up to 4 seconds. Adds normal fire damage; fire immunity and fire protection still apply. Requires Entity damage to be enabled.
gui.justifylasers.receiver.strength.tool: Output strength from 0 to 15. Applies to the five sides other than the optical input.
gui.justifylasers.receiver.inverted.tool: Normal: output while a matching laser is detected. Inverted: output when there is no matching laser. The master switch always disables output.
gui.justifylasers.receiver.filter.toolti: Accept any laser color or only the selected color. The model shows the incoming color even when the filter rejects it.
gui.justifylasers.receiver.emission.tool: Shader emission of the receiver's colored indicators while a beam reaches the front. Does not add Minecraft block light.
gui.justifylasers.damage_per_hit.tooltip: 0.1–20 HP per hit, before armor and other defenses. 2 HP = 1 heart. Use the arrow keys for fine adjustment.
gui.justifylasers.knockback.tooltip: 0–10× push per hit. 0× disables knockback; 1× is the original gentle push. Knockback resistance still applies.
gui.justifylasers.hits_per_second.toolti: 1–20 hits per 20 game ticks. 20/s hits every tick; 1/s hits once per second at 20 TPS. Lower server TPS slows the rate.
gui.justifylasers.beam_range.tooltip: 1–512 blocks along the entire beam path, including refocusing cubes. Only loaded chunks are traced. Arrow keys adjust by one block.
gui.justifylasers.module_hint: Install a crystal and the required modules.
guide.justifylasers.raw_wolframite: Mine wolframite ore with an iron pickaxe or better. It generates in new Overworld chunks between Y −32 and 64. Smelt one raw fragment in a normal furnace for 150 seconds to obtain one Wolframite Ingot.
guide.justifylasers.raw_photonic_crystal: Mine photonite at Y −56 to 24 with an iron pickaxe or better. Grow it with quartz, water and light, then combine it with a Crystal Mount. The resulting magenta laser crystal can be recolored in the Chemical Synthesizer.
guide.justifylasers.fuel_generator: Fuel determines heat and efficiency. Lava: 1200 C, 95%, up to 128 energy units/tick; sticks: 300 C. Heats by 0.2 C/tick and cools three times faster. Powers adjacent machines and charges tablets in the upper-right slot. Full buffers pause fuel consumption. The display shows live fuel, output, status, efficiency and temperature.
guide.justifylasers.crystal_growth_chamb:
Build eight growth casings into a 2×2×2 chamber. Supply LM to a lower optical lens; FE is not accepted. Basic recipe: raw photonite, two quartz and 1,000 mB water. At 480 klm it takes 30 seconds; speed scales with light.

Advanced recipes use a typed Growth Seed and matching nutrient instead. A Spectrum Module must condition the beam to the required hue. The menu shows the recipe's minimum LM; below it, paid work pauses. Internal rays appear only while a recipe runs. Cut advanced grown clusters in the Laser Cutter. See Cultivation for the complete chain.
guide.justifylasers.assembly_chamber:
Build eight Assembly Chamber blocks in a 2×2×2 cube. Supply FE, insert a reusable schematic and load materials. Ghost icons show accepted ingredients. Plans have different time and energy costs.

Record plans with the tablet and blank schematics. Recipes opens optional JEI; Help shows construction. All accessible sides support automation. Right-side tabs control privacy and redstone; private mode blocks external inventory access.
advancement.justifylasers.industry.alloy: Smelt a wolframite ingot in a furnace.
advancement.justifylasers.industry.cryst: Grow a photonite crystal in water.
guide.justifylasers.extraterrestrial_tab:
Find its first schematic in structure chests or obtain a copy from another player. Assemble with a Control Circuit, Eye of Ender, Wolframite Ingot and Gold Ingot, then charge in a Fuel Generator.

Use opens the handheld display. Help opens first: search items and scroll instructions with the mouse wheel. Schematics contains plans, search and a rotatable 3D preview. Keep blank schematics in your inventory and press Record to write a plan. You can record the tablet's own schematic too.

Capacity: 50,000 FE. The open display uses 1 FE/t; recording additionally costs 1,000 FE and one blank card.
tooltip.justifylasers.chamber_structure: Build a 2 × 2 × 2 chamber using eight casing blocks.
gui.justifylasers.industry.blueprint: Reusable schematic — selects the assembly recipe
tooltip.justifylasers.blueprint_tablet: Recorded using an Extraterrestrial Tablet and a blank schematic.
gui.justifylasers.tablet.charge_hint: Charge in an energy charger or Shift + use on a powered machine.
gui.justifylasers.tablet.interact: Use to interact • Drag the preview to rotate
gui.justifylasers.tablet.status.ready: Select a design • Drag the model to inspect
tooltip.justifylasers.dual_weapons: Two weapons: right-click — right hand · left-click — left hand
guide.justifylasers.advanced_thickness_m: Eight tier-I thickness upgrades in one item. Each installed module adds 8 FE/t; eight reach the width limit. Assemble from eight Thickness Modules and a Control Circuit.
gui.justifylasers.industry.seed_yield: One cluster per 1,000 mB nutrient. Cutting yields 3–6 resources. Seed wears after each batch.
guide.justifylasers.chemical_synthesizer: Makes nutrients and photopolymer and recolors laser crystals using FE and water. Separate 8000 mB input and output tanks support buckets and pipes. Recoloring needs any laser crystal, the matching reagent and 1000 mB water.
guide.justifylasers.laser_cutter: Build a 2×2×2 structure from eight cutter casings and assemble it with the configurator. Supply FE for the axes and a laser to a lower optical port for cutting. Converts grown crystals into usable resources. Both energy sources are required; interrupted work resumes without losing progress.
guide.justifylasers.spectrum_module: Craft at a workbench: eight different colored laser crystals, excluding white, around a Control Circuit. Install in the crystal slot or place in a beam. Choose RGB or a preset in its menu to tune the spectrum. The module consumes some optical flux.
